description: CCF: enforce plan mode for /ccf:plan, inject the context-first reminder + re-load the task after compact, nudge spec updates (single-channel systemMessage by default; opt-in via --dual-channel-stop to also inject additionalContext for the model), optionally (opt-in via --auto-verify) block a Stop to drive the verify chain (/ccf:check then /ccf:updatespec) when a task is in-review and code changed this session, warn about a proactive compact (systemMessage + additionalContext) when context enters the degrade zone, and inject a language-agnostic LSP/ripgrep/Glob exploration directive into the built-in Explore subagent.
